lineage.strategy: Add independent operating evidence on backlog, orders and capacity expansion for immediate Alpha reuse.

observations.fact: Powell's fiscal Q3 2026 results were reported at $312 million revenue, $934 million of new orders and a record $2.4 billion backlog; operating cash flow was $100 million and cash plus short-term investments were $634 million with no debt.
The report says capacity expansions, including the Jacintoport facility and new leases, are expected to support more than $100 million of incremental annualized revenue capacity.

risks.risk: Large project backlog is subject to project timing and mix; reported revenue growth was more modest than order growth, so backlog conversion cadence remains a key execution variable.

unknowns.unknown: Exact backlog conversion schedule, cancellation exposure and realized return on capacity expansion require issuer-level support.

recommendation: Use as source-addressed demand, liquidity and capacity evidence; corroborate numeric values against issuer filing before canonical numeric scoring.
